items: KATSINA STATE (PSI 9.2): Governor Radda Launches Virtual Courts, Judicial Welfare, and Grants for Student Innovators
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 9.1): Governor Namadi Approves N3.94 Billion for Constituency Projects, CBT Labs, SAPZ Land, and Water Schemes
GOMBE STATE (PSI 9.0): Gov Inuwa Yahaya Swears In Commissioners, Procures 1.72M RUTF Sachets with UNICEF, and Reshuffles Cabinet
EDO STATE (PSI 8.9): Edo Expands LIFE-ND to 18 LGAs, Pledges Rural Roads, Celebrates Oba's Coronation, and Hosts Rubber Summit
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.8): Adamawa Opens Bids for 300 Tractors, Fertilizer, and Rice; Fintiri Pledges New NUJ Secretariat
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.7): Governor Adeleke Deploys 24/7 AI, Drone, and Radar Security Platform with Shanghai Firm Shengwen IT
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.6): Governor Lawal Prepares Over 70 Completed Projects for Commissioning to Mark 30th Anniversary
EBONYI STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Nwifuru Nominated Sun Governor of the Year 2026 for Human Capital and Gratuity Clearance
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.4): Cross River Strengthens NSCDC Carnival Synergy and Flags Off Ember Month Anti-Extortion Traffic Campaign
YOBE STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov Buni Reviews Permanent Secretary Salaries and Welcomes 400 Indian-Trained 'Buni Scholars'
KEBBI STATE (PSI 8.1): Kebbi Government Clarifies Pension Entitlements for Garkuwan Yauri, Citing Constitutional Provisions
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 8.1): Gov Sule Hosts Chinese Ambassador Yu Dunhai to Discuss Mining Cooperation and Zero-Tariff Trade
RIVERS STATE (PSI 8.0): Governor Fubara Tasks 3,280 NYSC Corps Members on Community Development and SAED Wealth Creation
KATSINA (PSI 9.2): Declared open Legal Year announcing virtual courts, solar systems, and judge land plots, while pledging Songhai agribusiness training and N500k KASEDA grants.
JIGAWA (PSI 9.1): Approved N3.94bn across 6 council memos including N1.478bn constituency projects, N977m CBT/labs, N675m SAPZ land compensation, and Gender Education policy.
GOMBE (PSI 9.0): Swore in 3 Commissioners and 3 Special Advisers, received 1.72M RUTF sachets with UNICEF under N500m match, and launched Harmattan fire campaign.
EDO (PSI 8.9): Expanded LIFE-ND agribusiness to 18 LGAs, pledged rural road rehabilitation, congratulated Oba of Benin, and hosted IRRDB International Rubber Conference.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.8): Opened bids for 300 75-hp tractors, NPK fertilizer, and rice, while Governor Fintiri promised a modern NUJ Secretariat and operational bus.
OSUN (PSI 8.7): Partnered with Shanghai-quoted Shengwen IT to deploy a statewide AI, drone, radar, and safe-school surveillance system linked to a Command Centre.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.6): Finalized plans to commission over 70 completed projects across health, education, infrastructure, sports, and security for 30th state creation anniversary.
EBONYI (PSI 8.5): Nominated Sun Governor of the Year 2026, citing 3,800 public recruitment, ICT/Aerospace Universities, 280 conflict houses, and pension clearance.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.4): Strengthened NSCDC security synergy for Carnival Calabar and elections, and launched Ember Month campaign banning traffic officer extortion.
YOBE (PSI 8.3): Approved upward salary review for Permanent Secretaries and welcomed over 400 Indian-trained 'Buni Scholars' graduating in medicine and engineering.
KEBBI (PSI 8.1): Clarified legal pension guidelines for former Governor Garkuwan Yauri while highlighting ongoing medical trip sponsorships and Warah projects.
NASARAWA (PSI 8.1): Hosted Chinese Ambassador Yu Dunhai to discuss mineral exploration cooperation, curbing illegal mining, and China's zero-tariff African policy.
RIVERS (PSI 8.0): Passed out 3,280 NYSC Batch C Stream I corps members, urging selfless community service and SAED post-camp entrepreneurship participation.
